rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent stepped/bent mass in all four views, so it has decent gesture clarity and hierarchy. However, for neighborhood living it is too closed at the ground and the access edge is not convincingly transformed into a public threshold: the blue frontage reads adjacent to the object, but not materially answered by a court, undercut, or active seam. The form is also more like a generic tiered object than a ground-active mixed-use building; the stepped upper profile is coherent but not program-necessitated, and the section does not clearly support an active public lower zone. References with courtyard/public-edge qualities are more relevant than the tower-like or bridge-like counterfactuals. Overall, this is a plausible massing object but not yet program-fit enough to pass.
